epics.title: Root Cause Categorization for Design Review Concerns
epics.jtbd: When analyzing design review concerns, I want to categorize them by root cause pattern, so that repeating invariant patterns can be addressed systemically
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce uncategorized design review concern rate to 0%
requirements: R1: Assign a rootCausePatternId to underlying defect events when the reviewConcerns stream goes out of control with 8 consecutive same side points.

slices.title: Assign rootCausePatternId to out-of-control design review concerns
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pattern categorization for this epic, I want the backend to automatically assign a rootCausePatternId to defect events when the u-chart detects an out-of-control pattern, so that repeating invariant patterns can be addressed systemically
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an out-of-control 'reviewConcerns' stream with 8 consecutive points on the same side,
When the defect events are processed,
Then they must be assigned a new rootCausePatternId.
Given the implementation is complete, When tests run, Then unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the assignment logic.

epics.title: Deliver Missing API Slice D3a7a0f6
epics.jtbd: When deploying the API, I want all committed code to be present on main, so that the endpoint functions correctly.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce task resumption failure rate to 0%
requirements: R1: Expand isEligibleRetiredPlanTask to match reconcileClosedUnmergedPullRequest failures.
R2: Expose a single-task entry point resumeTask(UUID) and generate the missing OpenAPI contract.

slices.title: Implement resumeTask API and expand task recovery logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the missing API slice for this epic, I want to add the resumeTask(UUID) endpoint and update the recovery matcher, so that the endpoint functions correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task that failed due to reconcileClosedUnmergedPullRequest,
When isEligibleRetiredPlanTask is evaluated,
Then it matches the task.
Given a UUID,
When resumeTask is called,
Then the task is resumed.
Given the implementation is complete, When tests run, Then unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the recovery logic.

epics.title: Fix AutoMergeService Runtime Contract GitHub PR Reconciliation
epics.jtbd: When the orchestrator automatically merges PRs, I want the system to accurately match the PR to its task even if the session PR URL is null, so that successfully delivered work is correctly recorded as merged.
requirements: R1: Update AutoMergeService.reconcileMergedGitHubPullRequests() to match merged PRs to tasks without exclusively requiring a non-null session.getPrUrl().

slices.title: Fix PR reconciliation in AutoMergeService
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime contract fix for this epic, I want to update AutoMergeService to match PRs even when session.getPrUrl() is null, so that successfully delivered work is correctly recorded as merged.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with a null session PR URL,
When AutoMergeService.reconcileMergedGitHubPullRequests() runs,
Then the merged PR is correctly matched to the task.
Given the implementation is complete, When tests run, Then unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the reconciliation fix.
